SnowReport.Report:
Operations Update

We are so excited to get our 90th season started, and we know you have been anxiously waiting to hit the slopes of The Sun Mountain. We gave it everything we had to open this weekend, but some things, like warm ground temperatures, are out of our control. Making snow is a fine art and requires more than just cold air and a full snowmaking pond. Skiing and riding the signature snow surface Bromley has delivered for decades is always our highest priority, and we hope to be on snow as soon as possible.

While we will not be able to open for skiing & riding this weekend, sometimes the winters that start slow end up being the snowiest. We have been working hard behind the scenes to build winter from the ground up, and rest assured that we will continue to do whatever it takes. For now, stay stoked, and get ready to celebrate our 90th season once Mother Nature gives us the green light!

The newly refreshed Rental Center will be open Friday-Sunday, along with the Ticket Office, for all your pre-season needs. Fabulous new 90th Season merchandise has arrived at Potter Brothers Ski Shop, which will also be open this weekend for you to get a head start on your holiday shopping.

Our Cyber Sale is now live with 15% off KidsRule and $15 off fully transferable tickets with no blackouts!

Please note: Uphill travel is not permitted.

To stay up to date on the latest news, updates, and offers, make sure you **Sign Up for our Newsletter!**

**Lessons Now Available** - Whether it's your first time ever or first time in a while, we've got you covered with flexible lesson options. Try our **Adult Group Lessons** (new this year!) Where skiers and boarders 13+ can learn alongside others with a similar skill level in a supportive environment.

**26/27 Season Passes:** Ski/ride on the sunny side this winter. Lock in your Bromley pass for season-long fun in the sun.

**Ikon Session 3-Day:** As an added perk, Bromley Unlimited Passholders are eligible to purchase a heavily discounted Ikon Session 3-Day Pass.

**Preferred Parking Permit:** Save your legs for the slopes and guarantee a closer spot in our monitored preferred parking lot. (General parking is always free at Bromley)

November 26 Report: 
HAPPY THANKSGIVING! We wish you and yours a wonderful holiday! The Black Line tavern will be open Friday/Saturday  from 11a-10p with live music Friday from 5-8pm (the Olson Brothers Band) and Saturday from 3-6p with an Ullrfest Bonfire and Toast at around 5pm on the Alpen Deck! Sunday the BLT is open 11a-6p. Magic Merchants is open from 11-4pm Friday-Sunday for holiday shopping and the ticket office is open as well for  season pass, Throwback Card, Freedom 4-Pack and ticket purchases and RFID card pick-ups. All prices go up on December 1st.

Our snowmaking crew was able to  make snow again on Wand, Show Off and Base Area last night into this morning as the warmer air stayed aloft at the summit with the colder air  down low. By 10;30am temperatures are expected to be in the 30s so that will end this period of snowmaking as warmer weather and storm system take over tonight. Hopefully another window of cold will appear next week to resume snowmaking operations but the warmer El Nino pattern is here--coastal storms can still bring snow though.  Currently opening day is scheduled for December 12th. We will fight to do what we can, whenever we can! Stay tuned here for updates.

Recent news from Ski Magazine has Magic rated the #5 ski resort in the East based on their skier survey! Definitely a David vs Goliath story! We also ranked #2 in "Terrain Variety" and "Challenge" in the East. That's right on target. Magic packs a punch!

Our Black Friday sales are happening now and end on Cyber Monday at midnight 11/30. Freedom 4-Packs are 100% transferable ticket voucher codes at just $80/per ticket. Throwback Cards prices go up Dec 1 as do our Season Passes and day ticket prices. Don't miss out! 

Also, sign your children up for our Seasonal youth programs (Devo, Race and Freeride). Great coaching, skill development and just a great way to make life-long friends! Every weekend starting Christmas week!

UPHILL TRAVEL: CLOSED

Opening Day Update

We are going to give it to you straight: The weather Friday into Saturday is not giving us the opening weekend experience we want you to have, so we have made the decision to open next week as soon as conditions and temps allow. 

Snowmakers have made incredible progress on the mountain and have fired over 120 guns across 14 acres and 2,000 feet of vertical. They have capitalized on this very short weather window and have made every effort to lay down a base worth sliding on. 

If you can't wait to stop in and say hi, you're not alone! The Cannonball Pub will be open Friday and Saturday from 11am-5pm. Cannon Sport Shop, Tuning shop and Guest Services will also be open, and they can't wait to see you. Drop off your boards, start some holiday shopping and grab a beer!

Opening Day TBD: We don't have a specific date to drop yet. Stay Tuned, we will see you soon! 

Snowmaking Plan: Guns will continue to fire top to bottom through Thursday morning. Rain and warm weather will force a pause on snowmaking operations until Monday night. Tramway and Upper Cannon are looking nice and fat, so snowmakers will shift their focus to Profile Trail when we fire up again. The Lower Mountain filled in well over the last 24 hours but it will need another hit after this weekend's storm rolls over.

Bretton Woods Forecasted Alpine Snow Report for Sunday, November 29th 2026: 

We’ve got another day of early-season riding on tap, here are the latest terrain updates to help you plan your day tomorrow. Our beginner terrain options officially opened today, with the Learning Center Quad serving Rosebrook Meadow. Outer Bounds and Rangeview will be reachable via the Gondola or Zephyr Quad so you can enjoy top to bottom skiing. Afternoon sunshine should break up the morning clouds and transform corduroy into spring like skiing conditions. 

Once you get tired from that soft snow, take a break and stop into the Rosebrook Summit Lodge for a recovery drink and bite to eat at the Switchback Grille or stick around the Base Lodge for more options at Lucy Crawford’s Kitchen. Activities in the Base Lodge tomorrow will include the Slopeside Climbing Wall and indoor lawn games! Check out the Events and Activities section below for more details.   

Operational summary: The Gondola, Zephyr Quad, and Learning Center Quad will be open from 9:00 AM to 3:30 PM, providing access to Outer Bounds, Range View, and Rosebrook Meadow. Expect machine groomed and wet packed, spring type snow on intermediate/beginner terrain. Please note that uphill travel is not permitted at this time.  

For Your Safety: Remember to ski with caution, take it slow, and be aware of those around you. With limited terrain, trails may seem busier than usual, and we want to continue enjoying the slopes together. 

Plan Your Day: Season passes, day passes, rentals, and lessons are available for purchase on our online store. Save time and buy online to get to the slopes quicker.   

Events and Activities, Sunday, November 29th 

  • Slopeside Climbing Wall – Slopeside Level – 12:00 PM – 3:30 PM 
  • Lawn Games – Slopeside Level – 12:00 PM – 4:00 PM

Today we will have 9 trails open giving us 32 acres of skiable terrain. All open trails have been groomed. Open trails today will be intermediate and expert terrain with a hike park on Palmer's Way. Winter arrived last night, bringing 9 inches since 1pm yesterday. Snow is still accumulating quickly and there could be more snow by the time the lifts start spinning. 

Today, expect gusty winds and storm skiing conditions in the morning. The afternoon will see the skies clear up as the storm leaves the Tetons. Looking forward, there is more snow on the horizon in the coming days, so keep a close eye on our website as we open up additional lifts and trails.

Resort Update:

The Gadzoom, Wilbere and Chickadee are scheduled to start spinning at 9 a.m., conditions permitting. The Aerial Tram and Little Cloud are expected to have a delayed opening due to high winds at upper elevations. 

All uphill travel is closed and early-season conditions exist. Please be aware of objects at or below the snow surface. 

Mountain Report:

Happy Saturday! The storm that was forecasted for overnight got caught up in those classic Thanksgiving travel delays and is just now arriving at the mountain. We're now looking at 2-4 inches of fresh snow falling from 6-9a and light flurries continuing through 11a. Strong winds are accompanying the storm, so bundle up and keep an eye out for shifts to lift and terrain status throughout the day. 

But what about the skiing? How's the skiing?!? It's superb. The bumps are skiing soft and the groomers are holding an edge admirably. I'll be lapping Gadzoom today but you really can't go wrong wherever you choose to make your turns. 

No events on the calendar today, but might I suggest stopping by The Nest for their incredible Butter Chicken? It's so good that I, personally, consider it a glorious event every time I dig it. 

It’s early season, so take it easy out there. Ski and ride in control, respect closures and rope lines, and remember that lift and terrain availability can change throughout the day.

Give me The Bird.

Please note that pre-season uphill travel is not allowed, as our Mountain Operations teams need to prepare the mountain for opening. We appreciate your cooperation and understanding.

Last week’s back-to-back storms dropped over two feet of snow in four days, followed by cool temps that preserved the snowfall, allowing us to start the season early!

SnowReport.Report: Daily snow report updates will begin on December 1, 2026. November 22 Update: Winter is starting to make its presence felt at RED! We've currently got 18 cm of snow at our alpine weather plot , and snowmaking operations officially kicked off at the base this past weekend. It's still early days, but we're making progress as we prepare for the season ahead. Keep those snow dances going!

Fresh snow, 75 cm of snowfall so far, and winter continues to build. The Horse picked up around 14 cm during the latest storm cycle, bringing our season snowfall to 75 cm. The mountain is starting to build a little more coverage, and things are looking increasingly wintery up top as we work toward opening day. There's still more winter in the forecast, so we'll be keeping an eye on what the next storm cycle brings. This week's plans Staying Alive Avalanche Safety Conference | December 2 The Staying Alive Avalanche Safety Conference is coming up December 2. Saturday, November 28th, 6:50am.

Good morning Big Sky!

This is Eli with your daily conditions report. Last night the resort received 5" fresh inches of snow. Today the storm will continue into late morning then break into partly cloudy skies and periods of sunshine. For temperatures it is currently 22°F at Mountain Village with a daytime high of 30°F degrees and mid mountain high of 19°F. At the peak temperatures are 18°F, and an expected summit temp of 10°F.

Enjoy the fresh snow and we will see you on the trails!

It’s Saturday and a good day to hit the slopes. 35 trails are now open with skiing off 3 lifts, top to bottom, front and back with a 20 inch base of man made and natural snow. Snow showers are possible today but otherwise it will be partly cloudy on the mountain. Shuttles are running from the lower parking lots. Equipment rentals are available in the base area and at Purgatory Sports on Main Avenue. Skip the lines and get your lift tickets online at store.purgatory.ski, then download your ticket at our kiosks. Hold onto your ticket for the rest of the season and reload it as necessary. Be sure to checkout our lift ticket deals at Purgatory.ski/tickets. ATTENTION: As we continue to expand our open terrain, please be aware that early season conditions exist. Regardless of a trail being marked as green, all open terrain should be considered intermediate+ with variable early-season conditions.

Timberline is Closed for Skiing & Snowboarding: We plan to open for the winter season as soon as there is enough snow to responsibly operate. For everyone’s safety, respect closed areas. Active machinery and unmarked hazards do exist.

SnowReport.Report:
Mt. Bachelor is scheduled to open for the 26/27 winter season on December 4, conditions permitting. As always, we are committed to opening early if snowfall and conditions allow!

Mt. Bachelor's uphill policy takes effect when Mt. Bachelor opens for the 26/27 winter season, at which time a free Uphill Pass & armband are required. Until then, the slopes are uncontrolled and unpatrolled. Stay clear of snowmaking operations in the base area and on Thunderbird. There are high-pressure waterlines and high-voltage power lines between the hydrants and snowmaking guns. Call 911 in the case of an emergency. 

Mountain Gateway is open every weekend through Opening Day on December 4. Stop by the Mt. Bachelor Sports Pro Shop, featuring the PNW’s largest selection of premium ski and snowboard gear, great deals, and expert advice. Print your Season Pass at one of our PUBs, and pick up your Seasonal Rentals on the second floor.

Another night of snowmaking? Don't mind if we do.

Our snowmaking crew just put in its second full night of snowmaking! The team fired up the system a little before 6pm yesterday and kept things rolling through the night. Even when winds shifted directions, they didn't let that slow them down. Guns are still running this morning until temperatures rise, and we're planning to fire things back up tonight as soon as the cold returns. We're taking advantage of every opportunity to make snow, and every minute counts!

In other exciting news, Black Friday Deals are LIVE! You've got through December 3 to take advantage of some great deals on your next getaway. If you've been waiting for a sign to book, here it is.

And while you're here, Lights in the Sky is back! SkyBridge Michigan is glowing with holiday lights. [Click here for hours & details]

Keep those cold temps coming, Mother Nature.

The Highlands Is Closed for the Season - Ski You Soon!
The Highlands is a seasonal resort, which means we close for part of the year and reopen when winter returns. Right now, our snowmakers and team members are getting the mountain and lodge ready for the ski season, and we will announce our opening date as soon as we can. If Mother Nature delivers early, so will we! If Mother Nature struggles and, for some reason, we don't have enough snow and need to delay, we will wait until it makes sense and promise to keep you updated!

5:22 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Saturday, November 28, 2026.

The first Saturday of our winter operating season brings fresh snow: about two inches on the snow stake as of 5:20 AM, with an additional three to five inches throughout the day. Alpenglow chair will spin at 8:30 AM today, serving 1,000 vertical feet of terrain across two top-to-bottom runs, including Hornblower, Windmill, Klondike, and International.

Season pass prices go up Tuesday! Save with summer pricing on Eldora Season Passes and lesson products through Monday, Nov 30. Give yourself more days on snow, or give someone you love a winter they won't forget.

NWS Weather Snapshot: Snow showers, mainly before 5pm. Patchy blowing snow. Temperature falling to around 20 by 5pm. Windy, with a west wind 21 to 26 mph decreasing to 9 to 14 mph in the afternoon. Winds could gust as high as 43 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%. New snow accumulation of 3 to 5 inches possible.

Safety: No trees or glades are open yet. Expect thin, early-season conditions and be prepared to ski and ride safely and responsibly all season long, bearing in mind Your Responsibility Code every time you hit the slopes.

Uphill/Nordic/Snowshoe Access is currently CLOSED. For the cross-country skiers, snowshoers, and uphill skiers out there, Eldora’s Nordic trail network and uphill access routes are NOT YET OPEN. Stay tuned here for updates.

Parking: We will begin charging fees for single-occupancy vehicle (SOV) arrivals sometime in December. Stay tuned here for updates on when fees will begin. Learn more about parking at Eldora here.

Stay informed: Before heading to the mountain this winter, always check this page, eldora.com/conditions, for the latest information and operational updates. You can also sign up for text alerts so you never miss a beat. Text one of the following keywords to (866) 965-6224 for alerts (message and data rates may apply).

  • ELDORA for general alerts
  • UPHILL for uphill-specific updates
  • NORDIC for Nordic updates.

Thanks for checking the Eldora snow report. We'll see you on the hill!

--

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • Lift Hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekdays, 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM on weekends. Lifts currently open: Alpenglow only.
     
  • Lodge Hours: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM on weekdays, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM on weekends. Lodges currently open: Timbers, West Wing, Lower Indian Peaks Lodge.
     
  • Pass & Ticket Services, Rental, and Retail: Please visit Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. 
     
  • Single-Occupancy Vehicle (SOV) Fees: Vehicles with two or more occupants may park for free seven days a week. Vehicles carrying only a driver will be charged $10 on weekends, during certain holiday periods, and on weekdays with 10 or more inches of new snow. Credit/debit is accepted; cash is not.
     
  • High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Parking: Per Boulder County requirements, the Elk Lot (nearest to Alpenglow chair) is reserved seven days a week for vehicles with three or more occupants on a first-come, first-served basis. Learn more here.
     
  • EV Parking: Eldora provides 30 free ChargePoint EV charging stations. These premium parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to the SOV policy above. To park in the EV lot, you MUST have an EV and be actively charging. If you are finished charging, please move your car to another non-EV space so others can use the chargers.
     
  • Easy, Convenient RTD Bus Service from Boulder: RTD’s NB route brings you from Downtown Boulder Station straight to the Alpenglow chairlift in about 40 minutes; riders 19 and under ride RTD for FREE through RTD's Zero Fare for Youth program. For schedule and fare info, visit rtd-denver.com.
